subject: Latent growth curve model with individually varying time points

messages.author: 0f79caf2df6307bf
messages.subject: Latent growth curve model with individually varying time points
parts:
Is it possible to estimate growth curves with individually varying time points (e.g., time to event instead of time in study) in lavaan? And if so, how would I go about to specify this model? 

Thanks in advance!


Best regards,
Isabelle Hansson

Department of Psychology
University of Gothenburg
Gothenburg, Sweden

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Latent growth curve model with individually varying time points
parts: Is it possible to estimate growth curves with individually varying time points (e.g., time to event instead of time in study) in lavaan?

No.  I don't think there is a straight-forward way to incorporate this idea into parameter table that lavaan uses to represent its models (?lavaanify output).  If you are comfortable editing a JAGS or Stan syntax file, you could specify the basic growth model (with loadings fixed according to the number of waves) using the blavaan package, and save the JAGS or Stan syntax file. Then you can edit that to replace the constant loadings with person-specific specific loadings stored as additional variables in your data.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
